description:
𝗣𝗖𝗦-𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝘁𝗼 𝗙𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗛𝗼𝗼𝗱 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗹𝗹 𝗱𝗼𝗻’𝘁 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝗮 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲 𝘆𝗲𝘁? 𝗥𝗲𝗮𝗱 𝘁𝗵𝗶𝘀 👇

You don’t have to wait until you get here to have a place to call yours.

Joy & Dylan reached out to me on 𝗝𝗮𝗻 𝟮𝗻𝗱 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗛𝗮𝘄𝗮𝗶𝗶—thousands of miles away, a little nervous, and not sure where to even start.

Fast forward to now…  
🏡 𝗧𝗵𝗲𝘆 𝗷𝘂𝘀𝘁 𝗖𝗟𝗢𝗦𝗘𝗗 𝗼𝗻 𝗮 𝗯𝗿𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗻𝗲𝘄 𝗵𝗼𝗺𝗲  
📍 Less than 10 minutes to Fort Hood  
💰 Locked in a 𝟯.𝟵𝟵% 𝗳𝗶𝘅𝗲𝗱 𝗿𝗮𝘁𝗲 𝗳𝗼𝗿 𝟯𝟬 𝘆𝗲𝗮𝗿𝘀

And they did ALL of this virtually.  
No flights. No stress. No guessing.

Now all they have to do is land in May… and move straight into a home they already OWN 🤍

This is exactly why I love what I do.  
Helping military families feel taken care of—even from across the world.

Joy, thank you for trusting me and for this beautiful review. It truly means everything to me 🥹  
Can’t wait to welcome you home in May!

Thinking about buying before your PCS?  
Let’s make it happen ✨
